links.outcome: Diagnostic performance of third-party Alzheimer's system under universal black-box adversarial perturbations
links.effect: FGSM and DeepFool perturbations reliably degraded VolBrain diagnostic performance; DeepFool was more effective at comparable perturbation sizes; a simple Mean Attack also degraded performance. No numbers in the abstract.
links.quote: Our results show that these perturbations can reliably degrade the diagnostic performance of VolBrain, with DeepFool-based attacks being particularly effective for comparable perturbation sizes.

unlisted_practices: Adversarial robustness defenses for medical imaging AI, including third-party black-box platforms

screen.reason: Empirically tests the adversarial vulnerability/safety of an existing neuroimaging diagnostic tool (VolBrain) using simulated black-box adversarial attacks, but does not test a specific defensive deployment practice or safeguard.
